jobs.title: UX Researcher Role - 12 Months - FTC
jobs.reason: UX research for AI product development sits outside the candidate's target zones — this is product/design research, not AI policy, governance, or security research. The role requires HCI/cognitive science/experimental psychology backgrounds with usability studies and product strategy experience, which the candidate lacks; their IR/policy research methods don't transfer cleanly to UXR practice.

jobs.title: CAP and Remediation Manager
jobs.reason: Ethical sourcing/supplier compliance is outside the candidate's policy and intelligence focus. The role hard-requires 8+ years of experience in responsible sourcing/labor compliance, triggering the seniority ineligibility rule, and demands domain expertise (audit methodologies, CAPs) the candidate does not have.

jobs.title: Mystery Shopper (Spain)
jobs.reason: This is a freelance retail mystery-shopping gig with no connection to IR, policy, intelligence, or research. It also requires residence in Spain and effectively requires Spanish, a language the candidate does not speak. Clear mismatch on field.

jobs.title: Aerospace Auditor
jobs.reason: Complete mismatch — aerospace management-system auditing requires specialist industry certification and technical expertise the candidate does not possess. No overlap with IR, policy, or research work.

jobs.title: Project Manager – Research and Consulting (AD.10.4)
jobs.reason: The role requires at least 5 years of experience managing contract research or donor-funded projects as a hard minimum, which triggers seniority ineligibility. It is also a financial/contractual project management role rather than substantive research, and demands specialised expertise in funder compliance (EU, GIZ, WHO, etc.) and team leadership the candidate does not have.
